result.document_summary: A middle portion of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 3, Article 1 (Business Taxes), covering business tax payment, penalties, declarations, exceptions and tax rates, with no tenancy rules in this part.
result.notes: This part contains only business tax provisions (SDMC §§ 31.0131-31.0305). Although the source URL slug refers to a prohibition on algorithmic rent-setting devices (§ 98.1103), none of that text appears in this part, and nothing here falls within the six rental categories. The § 31.0305 apartment-house business tax text is truncated and is a tax rule, not a rental-regulation rule, so no rules are extracted.
